basedOn.description: Documents this one is based on (at most 50). Put only documents you actually used as a basis as TRACK; leave out sibling documents written alongside this one, or add them as REFERENCE. kind TRACK (default) records the source version and tells this document's owner when the source is updated so they can review it; REFERENCE is a plain link. If you read the source with get_document (or get_version), pass its readVersion as version — if that version was overwritten after you read it you get 409, read again. If readVersion is null (changes not yet saved as a version, or a type whose get_document does not return the whole content) read it with get_version and pass that readVersion, or omit version (always omit it when get_version's readVersion is null too). Omitting version records the latest version at save time and does not prove what you read. An existing tracking relation is confirmed to that version; an existing reference is promoted to tracking; kind REFERENCE never demotes a tracking relation (use document_relations SET_KIND). Relations not listed are left as they are.

version.description: The readVersion you got from get_document or get_version, as given

baseRevision.description: Optional: the document revision you read (get_document revision). If the document changed since, this item is not applied and the error is REVISION_CONFLICT with latestRevision.
